description: Interpretability of TWIST1 vs other craniosynostosis panel genes: VUS burden and P/LP yield in ClinVar
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

rows=[("TWIST1",363,159,141,42),("TCF12",656,175,288,159),("FGFR1",1480,315,572,437),
      ("FGFR2",1066,185,420,381),("FGFR3",1558,229,634,575),("EFNB1",381,203,105,44),
      ("ERF",355,75,180,86),("MSX2",298,31,143,119),("RUNX2",750,222,309,179),
      ("ALX4",374,43,181,138),("EFNA4",76,14,39,18),("ZIC1",247,33,112,98),
      ("IL11RA",220,103,37,61),("SMAD6",1418,97,860,386),("SPECC1L",569,65,320,161)]
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["gene","total","plp","vus","blb"])
df["pct_vus"]=100*df.vus/df.total
df["pct_plp"]=100*df.plp/df.total

# core coronal-synostosis differential panel
core=["TWIST1","TCF12","FGFR1","FGFR2","FGFR3","EFNB1","ERF"]
c=df[df.gene.isin(core)].copy()

# Is TWIST1's VUS fraction lower than the rest of the core panel pooled?
t=df[df.gene=="TWIST1"].iloc[0]
rest=df[df.gene.isin([g for g in core if g!="TWIST1"])]
a,b = int(t.vus), int(t.total-t.vus)
cc,d = int(rest.vus.sum()), int(rest.total.sum()-rest.vus.sum())
orr,p = fisher_exact([[a,b],[cc,d]])
print(f"TWIST1 VUS {a}/{int(t.total)} = {100*a/t.total:.1f}%  vs rest-of-panel {cc}/{cc+d} = {100*cc/(cc+d):.1f}%")
print(f"Fisher OR={orr:.3f}  p={p:.3e}")

# same for P/LP yield
a2,b2 = int(t.plp), int(t.total-t.plp)
c2,d2 = int(rest.plp.sum()), int(rest.total.sum()-rest.plp.sum())
orr2,p2 = fisher_exact([[a2,b2],[c2,d2]])
print(f"TWIST1 P/LP {a2}/{int(t.total)} = {100*a2/t.total:.1f}%  vs rest {c2}/{c2+d2} = {100*c2/(c2+d2):.1f}%  OR={orr2:.2f} p={p2:.3e}")

s=df.sort_values("pct_vus")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.5))
y=np.arange(len(s))
ax.barh(y, s.pct_plp, color="#b2182b", label="pathogenic / likely pathogenic")
ax.barh(y, s.pct_vus, left=s.pct_plp, color="#bdbdbd", label="VUS")
ax.barh(y, 100-s.pct_plp-s.pct_vus, left=s.pct_plp+s.pct_vus, color="#2166ac", label="benign / likely benign / other")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{g} (n={n})" for g,n in zip(s.gene,s.total)])
for i,(g,pv,pp) in enumerate(zip(s.gene,s.pct_vus,s.pct_plp)):
    ax.text(101, i, f"{pv:.0f}% VUS", va="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,118); ax.set_xlabel("percent of ClinVar records")
ax.set_title("TWIST1 has the lowest VUS fraction of the craniosynostosis panel genes\nClinVar, accessed 2026-11-26")
ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.95)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
